'Ask Xiaotuan' AI search assistant / 'AI Super Gateway' that handles complex natural-language local-services queries (e.g. finding hotels/restaurants by nuanced criteria) by connecting to Meituan's proprietary real-time merchant, traffic and location database; deployed as the primary in-app interaction method [Meituan (LongCat model)]

Autonomous food/grocery delivery drones using a computer-vision Visual Navigation System for perception and route planning plus an AI-based Unmanned Aircraft Systems Traffic Management (UTM) system for order processing and multi-drone scheduling; operational across multiple Chinese cities (and expanding to Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Dubai) [Meituan (in-house, >90% self-developed)]
deployments_detail.value: 170,000 delivery tasks completed; ~30% improvement in visual-flight positioning accuracy

deployments_detail.use: Autonomous sidewalk/road delivery vehicles ('little yellow robots') using self-driving technology to shuttle groceries and takeout in Beijing's Shunyi district and other approved demonstration zones since 2020, in a hybrid handoff model with human riders [Meituan (in-house)]

Real-time intelligent dispatch system / AI 'Super Brain' for instant delivery using operations-research and machine-learning algorithms (route planning with inverse reinforcement learning, delivery-time prediction, pricing and logistics optimization) processing real-time rider GPS/sensor data at massive scale in production [Meituan (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: 2.9 billion route-planning computations per hour at peak; average delivery time cut from ~60 to 30 minutes

deployments_detail.use: 'LongCat-Video' open-source foundational video generation model (13.6B parameters) for text-to-video, image-to-video and long video continuation (720p/30fps), released by Meituan's LongCat team, with a May 2026 audio-driven avatar variant (LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.5) [Meituan (LongCat team)]

'NoCode' AI coding agent that generates, deploys and modifies applications from natural-language conversation; originated from a 2023 internal hackathon, first served Meituan R&D teams, and is now used across business lines and by non-technical merchants/operators to build prototypes and tools [Meituan (in-house)]
